title: Grateful Dead Live at Bob Marley Performing Arts Center on 1982-11-26
source: (uncertain) Master Soundboard Cassette > Reel to Reel > DAT> CDR

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a mixed‑energy show that opens with a quirky Jamaican intro before Sugaree and delivers a standout Scarlet Begonias moment.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised as the best‑sounding version among several SBD sources, offering clear board mix and no noticeable technical flaws. Fans recall a memorable Jamaican spoken introduction that leads straight into Garcia’s “Sugaree,” and many cite the “Scarlet Fire” (likely Scarlet Begonias) as a highlight, though some listeners felt the overall show was a bit of a bummer, resulting in mixed impressions of the performance.

ai_rating.rationale: Recording quality is rated excellent, but show performance receives mixed feedback; weighted average yields a mid‑range rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as the best sounding of four available sources; clear and balanced board mix with no reported dropouts or noise.

standout_songs: Scarlet Begonias (referred to as Scarlet Fire)
show_quality.setlist_flow: Starts with a humorous Jamaican spoken intro leading into Sugaree; overall set is remembered fondly by tape traders but some feel the show was a bit of a bummer.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s launch into “Sugaree” after the Jamaican intro is specifically mentioned.
